prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–outbound release; accuracy/dispatch/safety/inventory compliance. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass) owns inventory/locations/eligibility/shipments/tasks/priorities; produces Slot Reservation Receipt, sends Dispatch Wave Amendment, receives Oversize Load Advisory/Aisle Occupancy Snapshot. Allocation requires availability/access/count/inspection/door-release/dimensional/mass/handling/clearance suitability; mismatches block automation. Holds preserve reason/scan/time/last-confirmed-location until validated disposition. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook) validates arrivals/discrepancies, blocks risk, receives Trailer Seal Exception Note from Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay). Desk checks identifiers/seals/paperwork/counts; segregates damage/holds; receives inspection advisory; records proceed/rework/hold. Inbound Pallet Buffer staging≠acceptance. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry) produces dimensions/Oversize Load Advisory, not placement authority. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane perform zoned moves; cross-aisle controlled. North receives reservation, verifies task/destination/access, sends occupancy snapshot; stale reports block induction. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor route separately. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven) checks identification/inspection/sensors/downstream readiness; single-pallet merges; produces/validates Transfer Induction Ticket; holds duplicates/uncertainty, preserves recovery order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur) checks vehicle/route/destination/safety/access; confirms pickup; produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation. Maintenance Release Terminal (Copperfield) records inspection/authorizer/repairs; produces Crane Service Release Card. North faults inhibit service; maintenance requires recorded fault/isolation; failed tests retain inhibition; successful tests require interlock/limit checks. Fire Alarm Panel produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice; panel/Safety Zone Controller retain stop/restriction authority. Outbound Dispatch Sorter follows authorized amendments/current plan. Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces Gross Weight Variance Slip; resolve via reweigh/documented-safe-disposition. Shipping Documentation Desk uses confirmed pallet/destination. Warehouse Operations Supervisor escalates holds/checks delays. Recovery: discrepancy/obstruction/alarm triggers isolation; Safety Zone Controller excludes entrants. Supervisor verifies personnel-clear authorization. Warehouse Management System reconciles sensors/locations; plan specifies travel-envelope/stopping-point/stop-conditions. South performs minimum reduced-speed recovery; personnel outside envelope, spotter

New part:
S195: Normal transfers resume in stages, with the first movements observed for unexpected interference or renewed alarms.
S196: Performance is assessed against transfer throughput, task completion time, equipment availability, and the rate of safely resolved exceptions.
S197: The Warehouse Management System records transaction times and reconciles completed movements against the active shift plan.
S198: At shift start, the Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews open alarms, equipment status, and the previous shift's unresolved work.
S199: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor confirms that operators understand current speed limits, exclusion boundaries, and stop-work criteria.
S200: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives the Transfer Induction Ticket and validates its destination against the assigned route.
S201: Fleet availability is measured as the proportion of scheduled operating time during which vehicles are ready for service.
S202: Route performance is reviewed using completed tasks, travel time, and the number of blocked or delayed movements.
S203: Safety checks verify that personnel detection, audible warnings, and emergency stops respond before production movement begins.
S204: Safety Zone Controller applies the Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice by maintaining the specified exclusion boundary until release criteria are met.
S205: The shift check confirms that the active boundary is visible to operators and enforced by the applicable control logic.
S206: Juniperwake verifies aisle clearance before resuming a stored-pallet movement and stops if an obstruction is detected.
S207: Moonquarry checks each pallet profile against configured dimensional limits and flags measurements outside tolerance.
S208: Dimensional exceptions are held for review rather than passed forward on an assumed measurement.
S209: The Outbound Checkweigh Scale is checked with a known reference load at the start of the shift and after maintenance.
S210: East Transfer Conveyor demonstrates a controlled restart by running empty at reduced speed for one complete cycle before accepting a pallet.
S211: The restart record includes the initiating authorization, observed speed, cycle result, and any alarm response.
S212: The Conveyor Line Controller inhibits feed if the restart cycle is incomplete or a protective device changes state.
S213: Maintenance Release Terminal status is checked before equipment is returned to automatic service.
S214: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor compares reported downtime with control-system event records at each shift review.
S215: Any unexplained difference is investigated before the affected performance measure is accepted.
S216: Near misses, protective stops, and repeated process delays are reviewed for corrective action and accountable ownership.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
